claims.claim: Emergent Retrieval is the project term for relevance produced when independently stored evidence dimensions overlap at query time; it does not mean information appears from nowhere.

claims.claim: Combining independent evidence dimensions can improve useful retrieval over the strongest single-axis baseline on realistic project tasks.
claims.counterhypothesis: Any observed gain is explained by a larger candidate budget, leakage, or semantic similarity alone.
claims.falsifier: Preregistered matched retrieval benchmark fails to improve task-relevant precision/recall/decision utility after controlling candidate budget and leakage.

claims.claim: Useful reflective agency improves when a capable model is coupled to typed persistent state, memory, perception, effect receipts and verified outcome re-entry plus an explicit reflection exit policy.
claims.counterhypothesis: A simpler scratchpad/tool loop with the same model and budget performs equally well, making the specific substrate unnecessary.
claims.falsifier: Matched end-to-end tasks show no improvement in recovery, state consistency, effect correctness, repeated-task adaptation or calibrated abstention versus the simpler baseline.

claims.claim: A model-specific vector-control ABI can produce stable label-independent semantic control across counterbalanced tasks.
claims.counterhypothesis: Observed effects are prompt/token/nuisance routing or activation transport without general semantic binding.
claims.falsifier: Preregistered model/runtime-specific dynamic-codebook interventions with nuisance/off-target controls and frozen holdouts fail to change behavior in the predicted semantic direction.

claims.claim: Preserving competing causal candidates until an evidence-bearing discriminator improves reversal/calibration over early single-candidate collapse.
claims.counterhypothesis: The extra branching mainly adds latency and complexity without outcome gains.
claims.falsifier: Matched tasks show no improvement in calibration, reversal accuracy or downstream outcome quality at comparable resource budgets.

claims.claim: ReAct is a methodological precedent for interleaving reasoning with actions that gather external information.
Reflexion is a methodological precedent for feedback-driven reflection stored in episodic memory to affect later trials.
Wu, Geiger and Milliere (ICML 2025) show a Transformer in a controlled symbolic-program setting progressing toward systematic variable dereferencing, studied with causal interventions.
SQLite WAL is an implementation mechanism for journaling/checkpointing database changes; it does not define EntityOS semantics.
CUDA Unified Memory is used only as a systems analogy for reducing explicit CPU/GPU memory ownership/copy boundaries; hardware coherence is not database/evidence semantics.
